hero.title: TechnoAi Registered as Official Supplier on Abu Dhabi Government Procurement Gate

blocks.html: TechnoAi is proud to announce that we have successfully completed our registration as a government supplier in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi through the Department of Government Enablement, marking an important milestone in our continued growth and commitment to supporting the UAE’s innovation-driven economy.

This achievement reflects the trust placed in TechnoAi as a reliable partner capable of delivering advanced technology solutions, strategic procurement services, and integrated supply chain and logistics support to government entities and leading organizations across the region.
At TechnoAi, we focus on enabling organizations with access to cutting-edge technologies and streamlined operational solutions, including:

items: AI infrastructure and high-performance computing solutions
Enterprise AI services and intelligent automation
Strategic technology procurement and global sourcing
Supply chain optimization and logistics solutions

blocks.html: As part of our long-term commitment to contributing to the UAE’s economic development, TechnoAi is also aligning its operations with the objectives of the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology and theIn-Country Value (ICV) program, reinforcing our dedication to supporting local economic growth, responsible sourcing, and sustainable partnerships.

We look forward to collaborating with government entities, research institutions, and industry leaders to deliver impactful solutions that support the UAE’s vision for innovation, digital transformation, and advanced industry.
TechnoAi Empowering Innovation Through Technology, Procurement, and Intelligent Infrastructure.
Abu Dhabi Government Procurement Gate(ADGPG)

The Abu Dhabi Government Procurement Gate is the official procurement platform that connects Abu Dhabi government entities with registered suppliers. The platform facilitates transparent sourcing, vendor registration, and procurement management across various sectors, enabling government organizations to access qualified suppliers and streamline purchasing processes.
